channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Takaichi administration approves ordinance outlining secondary capital requirements
item.description: Of the 47 prefectures, only Hokkaido, Aichi, Osaka and Fukuoka meet the necessary conditions.

item.title: Manga artist Tetsuya Chiba, creator of ‘Ashita no Joe,’ dies at 87
item.description: Born in Tokyo in 1939, Chiba was the first manga artist to receive the Order of Culture, one of Japan's highest cultural honors.

item.title: Japan mulls registration of foreign agents under new anti-espionage law
item.description: Under the plan, people acting on behalf of foreign governments would have to register with relevant authorities to make their activities transparent.

item.title: LDP proposes gradual reduction of fuel subsidies
item.description: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has ordered industry minister Ryosei Akazawa to consider reviewing the subsidy program.

item.title: Japan is known for world-class events - but the Asian Games were chaotic
item.description: Hotel chaos, transport mishaps and diplomatic blunders cast a spotlight on organisers and the firm hired to deliver the games.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
